atoms.a: Why would a dash be used in a sentence?
b: to indicate a change in narrator
++to separate additional information from the rest of the sentence

instruction.text: Complete the sentences by adding the correct punctuation.

atoms.b: There are 52 weeks in a year ((++– --.)) that’s 365 days((--– ++.))
atoms.sound: There are 52 weeks in a year – that’s 365 days.

atoms.b: The UK government has two houses ((++– --.)) the House of Commons and the House of Lords((--– ++.))
atoms.sound: The UK government has two houses – the House of Commons and the House of Lords.

atoms.b: There are 8 planets orbiting the Sun in our solar system ((++– --.)) Earth is the third closest to the Sun((--– ++.)) Earth is the only place where life has been discovered ((++– --.)) most of the surface is made up of water((--– ++.))
atoms.sound: There are 8 planets orbiting the Sun in our solar system – Earth is the third closest to the Sun. Earth is the only place where life has been discovered – most of the surface is made up of water.

atoms.b: Some places don’t experience all four seasons the way others do((--– ++.)) The climate in California, for example, is Mediterranean-like ((++– --.)) the summers are warm and the winters are mild((--– ++.)) This means that in winter, the average temperature is rarely lower than 10 degrees Celsius((--– ++.))
atoms.sound: Some places don’t experience all four seasons the way others do. The climate in California, for example, is Mediterranean-like – the summers are warm and the winters are mild. This means that in winter, the average temperature is rarely lower than 10 degrees Celsius.

instruction.text: Drag the dash to the correct place in the text.

atoms.b: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius((++–))it will only snow when the temperature reaches freezing point.
atoms.sound: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius – it will only snow when the temperature reaches freezing point.

atoms.b: We have 6 exams at the end of the year((++–))I need to start revising soon.
atoms.sound: We have 6 exams at the end of the year – I need to start revising soon.

atoms.b: There are so many good films on at the cinema((++–))let’s decide what to watch beforehand.
atoms.sound: There are so many good films on at the cinema – let’s decide what to watch beforehand.

atoms.b: Climate change means that many species are at risk of going extinct((–)) these include types of leopards, lions and tigers.
atoms.sound: Climate change means that many species are at risk of going extinct – these include types of leopards, lions and tigers.
